svg.title: Level 3, the map
svg.desc: Level 3 drawn from its level file, 50 by 16 tiles, par 200. Kettle starts at the right, under the bell. A belt running left leads to a spike pit that crosses the runway. The bell's four drop places sit over the pit in row 13, at columns 6, 9, 12, 15. The flag is at the far left, behind a wall one tile thick. No route is drawn.
svg.text: Level 3, drawn from its level file
50 by 16 tiles, par 200 frames. The dashed squares
